name: Levetiracetam
executiveSummary: Anticonvulsant. Adult load **60 mg/kg IV** (max **4500 mg**); maint. **500–1500 mg every 12 h**. Pediatrics up to **60 mg/kg/day**. Neonates: load **40–60 mg/kg** → maint. **20–40 mg/kg/day** every 12 h.
indications:
## Indications

- Seizures / status (adjunct); epilepsy.

## Precautions

- Adjust in CKD/hemodialysis. Taper gradually.

> Dilute IV and infuse ~15 min (neonates common conc. **5 mg/mL**).

adulto.presentation: Vial 500 mg/5 mL IV; tablets PO.
adulto.dose: Load 60 mg/kg IV (max 4500 mg); maintenance 500–1500 mg every 12 h PO.

pediatrico.presentation: Tablets: 500–1000 mg; PO solution: 100 mg/mL; vial 5 mL: 100 mg/mL
pediatrico.dose: Ages 4–16 years: initial 10–20 mg/kg/day every 12 h, increase 10–20 mg/kg/day every 2 weeks up to max 60 mg/kg/day every 12 h. Adults: initial 500 mg every 12 h, increase 1000 mg/day every 2 weeks up to max 3000 mg/day. Adjust dose in renal impairment and hemodialysis. See levetiracetam dose adjustment in altered renal function.
pediatrico.notes: IV administration: Dilute the dose in 100 mL NS or D5W and give over 15 min (neonates: 5 mg/mL). Taper gradually to minimize increased seizure frequency.

neonatal.dose: Load **40–60 mg/kg IV** over ~15 min; maintenance **10–20 mg/kg/dose every 12 h** (**20–40 mg/kg/day**), titrate to response — neonatology.
neonatal.notes: Renal adjustment; do not stop abruptly.

stability:
## Stability

- IV dilution 4 h room temperature per package insert.

## Pediatric guide

- Discard remainder once opened. Dilution stable 24 h at room temperature.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Asthenia, depression, nervousness, somnolence, infection, ataxia, dizziness, vertigo, seizures.
